def VTask.sumLexLift {α₁ : Type u_1} {α₂ : Type u_2} {β₁ : Type u_3} {β₂ : Type u_4} {γ₁ : Type u_5} {γ₂ : Type u_6} (f₁ : α₁ → β₁ → Finset γ₁) (f₂ : α₂ → β₂ → Finset γ₂) (g₁ : α₁ → β₂ → Finset γ₁) (g₂ : α₁ → β₂ → Finset γ₂) : α₁ ⊕ α₂ → β₁ ⊕ β₂ → Finset (γ₁ ⊕ γ₂) :=
  fun a b =>
    match a, b with
    | ⟨a, h⟩, ⟨b, h'⟩ =>
      have h₁ : Finset (γ₁ ⊕ γ₂) := (f₁ a b).image (fun x => inl x)
      exact h₁
    | ⟨a, h⟩, ⟨b, h'⟩ =>
      have h₂ : Finset (γ₁ ⊕ γ₂) := ∅
      exact h₂
    | ⟨a, h⟩, ⟨b, h'⟩ =>
      have h₃ : Finset (γ₁ ⊕ γ₂) := (g₁ a b).image (fun x => inl x) ∪ (g₂ a b).image (fun x => inr x)
      exact h₃
    | ⟨a, h⟩, ⟨b, h'⟩ =>
      have h₄ : Finset (γ₁ ⊕ γ₂) := (f₂ a b).image (fun x => inr x)
      exact h₄
